entities.summary: Alejo Vidal-Quadras Roca is a Spanish former politician and radiation physicist. Born in Barcelona, he served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 1999 to 2014 and as First Vice-President of the European Parliament from 2004 to 2007. He survived an assassination attempt in 2023, he says was ordered by Iran, which became known in Spain as "The Sunflower case".
